sloka: या पुत्रम् पार्थिव इन्द्रस्य प्रवासयति निर्घृणा ।कः ताम् प्राप्य सुखम् जीवेद् अधर्म्याम् दुष्ट चारिणीम् ॥२-४८-२४॥
transliteration: yā putram pārthiva indrasya pravāsayati nirghṛṇā ।kaḥ tām prāpya sukham jīved adharmyām duṣṭa cāriṇīm ॥2-48-24॥

translations.english: Who can live with pleasure under the rule of Kaikeyi of unrighteous character and wicked behaviour, one who without compassion banished Rama, son of Dasaratha, king of kings?
